description: This file sets up a global configuration for Allure reporting in NUnit tests for the OrangeHRM Selenium project. It configures the results directory for Allure reports and ensures cleanup before test execution.

classes.name: AllureSetup
classes.description: Provides a one-time setup for configuring Allure report output directory before NUnit tests are run.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Initializes the environment variable for Allure results directory and cleans existing results directory before executing tests.
